# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and housekeeper at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman with strong angles and a sallow cheek. Her dark, gray-streaked hair is worn twisted up behind her head in a hard little knot fastened aggressively with two wire hairpins. Over nine years, her expression softened and her mouth lost much of its hardness, giving way to gentler eyes and a more frequent smile.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla is a practical, sensible, and self-contained woman with a rigid conscience and strict moral discipline. Though she is brusque, stoic, and sometimes sarcastic—especially when suffering from headaches—she possesses a hidden sense of humor and a deep capacity for tenderness. She is deeply devoted to her duties and hesitates to display open emotion or pride, though over time she mellows into a much milder and more forgiving guardian.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), [v1 c23 P25](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0025), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

- Fulfilling her duty and providing a good education for Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031)</sub>
- Drilling Anne into tranquil uniformity and demure manners  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>

## History

Marilla lived at Green Gables with her brother Matthew for many years. When they decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, a mistake resulted in Anne Shirley arriving instead; though initially determined to return her, Marilla decided to keep and raise the girl. Over the years, she managed the household while strictly disciplining Anne, though she gradually grew deeply devoted to her. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the strain of managing Green Gables and declining eyesight from severe eye strain and headaches. After Anne chose to stay home to teach in Avonlea, Marilla took in her deceased relative Mary Keith's twin young children, Davy and Dora. After several years of raising the twins alongside Anne, Marilla looked back on her life and felt that her true living only began after Anne entered her home.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Hurt as a young child by hearing an aunt remark on her dark, homely appearance  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Quarreled with her childhood beau, John Blythe, and refused to forgive him  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Raised in strict childhood discipline, always keeping quiet when told  <sub>[v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030)</sub>
- Lived at Green Gables her whole life  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
